slides.title: Texto 3: perfil de estudiante
body: **Program:** Animation and Visual Effects Engineering · **Quarter:** 3rd · **Group:** IAEV-31

**About me:** Hi! I'm from San Juan del Río, but I live in Santa Rosa Jáuregui with my aunt. I've got two younger sisters. I love drawing and playing video games. I don't like getting up early, but my classes start at 7 a.m.!

items.s: Diego lives in San Juan del Río.
